description: This file defines the MessageFormatterInterface, an interface specifying a method for formatting HTTP messages with associated request, response, and error data within the Guzzle HTTP client library.

classes.name: MessageFormatterInterface
classes.description: An interface defining the method for formatting HTTP message data into a string representation.

methods.name: format
methods.description: Returns a formatted string representing an HTTP message, given a request, optional response, and optional error.
